bestFor: 2, 4, 6, 8 or 9 screenshots of equal importance — a feature matrix or a before/after set. The safest default when no single image should dominate.
notes: Column count prefers an exact divisor of the image count, so 4 renders as a clean 2x2 rather than 3x2 with two empty cells. Counts that are prime (5, 7) leave one gap by necessity — add or drop an image to avoid it.
